name: FluxWorks
title: FluxWorks
author: Raziphel, FluidNatalie
description:
FluxWorks is a full-scale Space Age industrial overhaul built for players who want every era of the factory to matter.

Rebuild Nauvis around mixed deposits, expanded metallurgy, ceramics, petrochemistry, componentized machines, and an AAI-powered early game. Then master four Flux disciplines—Matter, Chemical, Fuel, and Bio—whose production chains intertwine with orbit and every Space Age planet.

Recover material value from thousands of items through confidence-aware, exploit-resistant Flux extraction. Build specialized processing plants, planetary symbiosis industries, phase logistics, deep storage, and an interconnected science program that carries one factory from burner industry to promethium.

Beyond Aquilo waits the hostile Shattered Planet: harvest spectral vents, endure ion storms, forge origin-scale megastructures, and awaken the Origin Singularity for a true endgame.

Six worlds. Four spectra. One factory transformed.
